summary: One-frame event of ecl::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem (written in ProcessScreenFadeToRequests / ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests / FinalizeComponents, whose WorldView names all four screen_fade one-frame events). Holds a set of short player ids: players whose fade-to request was cancelled. Born live together with camera ScreenFadeTo/ClearScreenFade manual requests and SnapFadeRequest (cinematic/scene steps).
